00290 bool SequenceValueInternal::checkLoop() throw()
00291 {
00292  bool loopedThisTime = false;
00293  
00294  switch (loopType) 
00295  {
00296   case FixedNumSteps: {
00297    currentStep++;
00298    if(currentStep >= numSteps_)
00299    {
00300     loopCount++;
00301     currentStep = 0;
00302     loopedThisTime = true;
00303     
00304     if(loopDirection_ == Normal)
00305      currentValue = start_.getValue();
00306    }
00307   } break;
00308   case ThresholdIncreasing: {
00309    if(currentValue >= threshold_.getValue())
00310    {
00311     loopCount++;
00312     loopedThisTime = true;
00313     
00314     if(loopDirection_ == Normal)
00315      currentValue = start_.getValue();
00316     else {     
00317      Value temp = start_;
00318      start_ = threshold_;
00319      threshold_ = temp;
00320      
00321      loopType = ThresholdDecreasing;
00322     }
00323    }
00324   } break;
00325   case ThresholdDecreasing: {
00326    if(currentValue <= threshold_.getValue())
00327    {
00328     loopCount++;
00329     loopedThisTime = true;
00330     
00331     if(loopDirection_ == Normal)
00332      currentValue = start_.getValue();
00333     else {     
00334      Value temp = start_;
00335      start_ = threshold_;
00336      threshold_ = temp;
00337      
00338      loopType = ThresholdIncreasing;
00339      
00340      //?currentValue = start_.getValue();
00341     }
00342    }
00343   } break;
00344   default:
00345    ; // otherwise do nothing
00346  }
00347  
00348  return loopedThisTime;
00349 }

00367 double SeriesValueInternal::getValue() throw()
00368 {
00369  double returnValue = currentValue;
00370  double growValue = grow_.getValue();
00371  currentValue += growValue;
00372  
00373  if(checkLoop())
00374  {
00375     grow_ = -grow_;
00376     
00377     if(loopDirection_ == Alternate)
00378     {
00379      currentValue -= growValue;
00380      if(loopCount % 2) 
00381       currentValue -= growValue;
00382     }
00383  }
00384  
00385  return returnValue;
00386 }

00418 double GeomValueInternal::getValue() throw()
00419 {
00420  double returnValue = currentValue;
00421  double growValue = grow_.getValue();
00422  currentValue *= growValue;
00423  
00424  if(checkLoop())
00425  {
00426     grow_ = Value(1.0) / grow_;
00427     
00428     if(loopDirection_ == Alternate)
00429     {
00430      if((loopCount % 2) == 1) {
00431       currentValue /= growValue;
00432       currentValue /= growValue;
00433      }
00434     }
00435  }
00436  
00437  return returnValue;
00438 }

00696 void ValueUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00697 {
00698  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00699  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00700  
00701  while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00702  {
00703   *outputSamples++ = (float)valueObject.getValue();
00704  }
00705 }
00706 
00707 void ValueUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00708 {
00709  const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00710  unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00711  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00712  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00713  
00714  int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00715  
00716  while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00717  {
00718   float nextValue = value;
00719   
00720   if(numKrSamples == 0)   
00721   {
00722    nextValue = (float)valueObject.getValue();
00723   }
00724   
00725   numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;  
00726   blockPosition  += numKrSamples;
00727   
00728   if(nextValue == value)
00729   {
00730    while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00731    {
00732     *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00733     --numSamplesToProcess;
00734     --numKrSamples;
00735    }
00736   }
00737   else
00738   {
00739    float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00740    
00741    while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00742    {
00743     *outputSamples++ = value;
00744     value += valueSlope;
00745     --numSamplesToProcess;
00746     --numKrSamples;
00747    }
00748    
00749    value = nextValue;
00750   }
00751  }
00752  
00753 }
